title: What Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Small modular reactors are nuclear power plants shrunk to 50-300 MW and built in factories: standardized modules shipped to site, with passive safety that cools the core with no operator action or external power — nuclear power as a manufactured product. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Small Modular Reactors (SMRs): start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) in one line: Small modular reactors are nuclear power plants shrunk to 50-300 MW and built in factories: standardized modules shipped to site, with passive safety that cools the core with no operator action or external power — nuclear power as a manufactured product.
Why it matters: They promise nuclear's clean baseload at lower cost, faster build times, and siting flexibility..
Where it is used: grid baseload, industrial heat, remote communities, desalination, hydrogen..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
